name: Octree-based Voxel Terrain Voxelization
definition: A voxel terrain representation using an octree where the root node encapsulates the entire terrain bounds as a perfect cube with dimensions that are a power of two, ensuring neat subdivision of child nodes.
summary: Octree-based Voxel Terrain Voxelization efficiently generates sparse voxel grids by recursively subdividing octrees only where they intersect the terrain surface, avoiding dense volume allocation.
